context:
# Goal
Mori round16 C1 coverage (lowest owned6 versus operability7): acquire bounded, MESSAGE-free, same-boot new-since-anchor journal observation. FR11 advances only for exact retained cursor continuity; missing/vacuumed anchor, boot boundary, failed/truncated capture stay unavailable. No census cutover, no cursor state mutation, no authenticated emitter/unique victim/completeness claim. L1 MoriR16 holds canonical planner. Source S014/S015 and cursor API primary documents must be opened this round. Previous non-author round15 feedback must become append-only corrections and active registry fix; old drift pin remains red, no re-pin.
# Contract
All writes ONLY /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mori-shokunin in your exact assigned file plus your absolute report path. every `Report:` trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mori-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mori-shokunin/<that path>. Never write fleet files or another lane, never use /tmp for deliberate probes/downloads; isolated selftest temp trees are permitted only when L1 later executes selftest. Never agent://all; message ONLY exact seat id or L1 agent://MoriR16, never orchestrator/Main. Every seat is leaf; skip ALL builds/tests/lint/formatters/gates/smoke runs; implementing a selftest is NOT permission to execute it. L1 verifies once after all seats settle. Never commit. Never read/copy/query/change ~/.omp/agent/agent.db* or any credential/auth file; never launch omp CLI. Helpful official tools allowed after reading ~/.omp/agent/RULES.md; record tool/version/channel/reason. ALL pacman transactions PAUSED host-wide; use uv tool/npx/official binary in ~/.local/bin or report L0 need; no downgrade/restart/host changes.
# Interface
Production tools/mori-journal-window.py CLI --anchor PATH --scope user|system [--journalctl PATH] [--timeout SECONDS] [--max-bytes N], stdout one JSON object, no file writes; --selftest isolates actual CLI subprocess tests, asserts rc+stable finding id, no network/live reads. Anchor exactly schema mori-journal-anchor-v1, scope, boot_id(32 lowercase hex), cursor(opaque printable scalar <=4096, no controls). Query one scope with --cursor=<anchor> --no-tail --quiet --output=json --output-fields=__CURSOR,_BOOT_ID,MESSAGE_ID,UNIT_RESULT,EXIT_CODE,EXIT_STATUS; never MESSAGE, never --after-cursor without proving anchor. First parsed record must have EXACT anchor cursor+boot; drop it. Every later record must be object, same boot and unique valid scalar cursor. Malformed/empty capture, missing/mismatched/duplicate cursor, foreign boot, nonzero rc, stderr, timeout, overflow -> rc2 unavailable, no numeric positive totals. Successful window returns rc0 with finding_id=MORI_JOURNAL_WINDOW_OK, scope, records_after_anchor, four separate positive_kernel_oom/positive_unit_oom/positive_unit_signal/positive_process_sigkill counts using r15 predicates, evidence_basis=validated-record-subsets, no alarm/severity override or victim count. Any unavailable returns rc2, finding_id=MORI_JOURNAL_WINDOW_UNAVAILABLE, reason stable; setup invalid anchor/args -> rc2 MORI_JOURNAL_WINDOW_SETUP. Anchor never advanced automatically. End cursor optional reported but not written. stdout MUST NOT echo raw cursor or records; safe anchor SHA256 allowed.
# Fixture and harness contract
Each pack is JSON {"cases":[{"id":"unique","scope":"user","anchor":{"schema":"mori-journal-anchor-v1","scope":"user","boot_id":"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa","cursor":"anchor"},"stdout":"JSONL escaped string","stderr":"","returncode":0,"want_rc":0,"want_id":"MORI_JOURNAL_WINDOW_OK","want":{"records_after_anchor":0}}]}. Optional timeout:true / overflow:true instruct wrapper to delay or overflow, with expected rc2. Use literal JSONL strings. Every pack includes at least one success or refusal specific to its topic. Harness tools/mori-round16-regressions.py --tool PATH --fixtures DIR --output DIR; pin expected input digests via --pin-fixtures PATH then normal --expected PATH (must validate every pack digest and tool digest before runs); missing tool at entering baseline records capability_absent, expected finite cases fail (not production bug). Runs actual CLI subprocess using per-case executable journalctl wrappers; writes all raw streams and manifest with input hashes start/end, actual git HEAD, exact porcelain; refuses moving inputs. --selftest actual isolated CLI arms rc+id. Never execute now. No shared writes to another owner; reports are advisory author-lane evidence, never outside verification.
Explicit prohibitions: NO LIVE journalctl queries or journal reads; NO measurement/probe loops or synthetic behavior tests; NO background jobs; NO /tmp or /run/user staging/download/probe outputs. --version/--help and static local man reads are allowed only without outside-lane redirection. Each seat writes ONLY its assigned file(s) and report. Never touch sibling-owned shared files.
